metadata.description: Two Claude Code plugins: p4-phi, which keeps what linked sessions hand each other and retrieval from the project's own history; and p4-temportal, which keeps what stands in for a default of Anthropic's own system: the auto memory directory, the session scratchpad directory, temp files and their lifetimes.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Stands in for three of Claude Code's own places inside the project: the auto memory directory, the session scratchpad directory and temporary files, with lifetimes that clear what is no longer relevant.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked Claude Code sessions hand each other, and retrieval from the project's own history: rule and fact lines beside a message or a subagent's task when the ranker is confident, an earlier answer in place of a repeated web lookup, and what worked after a failure an earlier session met.
